nodes.description: msg.sender - externally controlled caller used as authorization and transfer origin throughout MarsGenesis
MarsGenesis.transfer(address,uint) public payable - forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as _from
MarsGenesis.transferFrom(address,address,uint) public payable - allowance check, ensure() gate, unchecked balance/allowance mutation and _onSaleNum increment
MarsGenesis.approve(address,uint) public payable - writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-value guard
MarsGenesis.ensure(address,address,uint) internal view - whitelist bypass (owner, tradeAddress, UNI, derived pair, canSale) else condition() requirement
MarsGenesis.condition(address,uint) internal view - enforces _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale trading limits per sender
MarsGenesis.delegate(address,bytes) public payable - owner-only arbitrary delegatecall
MarsGenesis._mints(address,uint256) public - privileged balance overwrite requiring msg.sender to be owner or one of five hardcoded addresses
MarsGenesis.init(uint256,uint256,uint256) public - owner-only sale parameter initialization
MarsGenesis.batchSend(address[],uint) public payable - owner-only mass distribution with unchecked multiplication and loop balance additions
MarsGenesis.setTradeAddress(address) public - owner-only update of tradeAddress whitelist entry
MarsGenesis.pairFor(address,address,address) internal pure - computes Uniswap pair address via keccak256
MarsGenesis constructor - sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and unlimited allowance to Uniswap router
address private owner - privileged authority set to msg.sender
mapping(address=>uint) public balanceOf - token balances mutated without safe math
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) public allowance - approvals mutated without safe math
address tradeAddress - whitelisted trading address checked in ensure()
mapping(address=>bool) private canSale - per-address sale permission flag
mapping(address=>uint256) private _onSaleNum - per-address sale counter
uint256 private _saleNum - maximum number of sales per address
uint256 private _minSale - minimum transfer amount
uint256 private _maxSale - maximum transfer amount
uint public totalSupply - total token supply
uint constant public decimals - 18, used in scaling arithmetic
string public name - token name
string public symbol - token symbol
address constant UNI - Uniswap V2 router address used as special whitelist entry
a.delegatecall(b) - arbitrary delegatecall allowing external code to mutate contract storage
address(token).call(data) inside SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn - low-level external call on arbitrary token
balanceOf[_from] -= _value and allowance decrement performed without SafeMath (unchecked arithmetic)
SafeERC20.callOptionalReturn(IERC20,bytes) private - contract check, low-level call and optional return decode
parameter _to - recipient address in transfer/transferFrom
parameter _value - transfer amount in transfer/transferFrom
parameter _from - source address in transferFrom/ensure/condition
parameter _spender - spender address in approve
parameter a - delegatecall target contract in delegate
parameter b - calldata payload in delegate
parameter spender - recipient of minted balance in _mints
parameter addedValue - token amount used to overwrite balance in _mints
parameter saleNum - per-address sale cap assigned to _saleNum in init
parameter token - minimum sale amount in init
parameter maxToken - maximum sale amount in init
parameter _tos - recipient array in batchSend
local i - loop index in batchSend
parameter addr - new trade address in setTradeAddress
parameter factory - Uniswap factory address in pairFor
parameter tokenA - first pair token in pairFor
parameter tokenB - second pair token in pairFor
local pair - computed pair address returned by pairFor

edges.reason: msg.sender is supplied as _from when transfer delegates to transferFrom
msg.sender determines allowance check/decrement and is the default _from path
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner written by approve
_mints gates minting on msg.sender being owner or a hardcoded whitelist address
init requires msg.sender == owner to set sale limits
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner to mass distribute balances
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner to whitelist an address
constructor assigns owner and full supply to msg.sender
transfer forwards all logic to transferFrom
transferFrom requires ensure() to pass before mutating balances
transferFrom performs unchecked balance and allowance subtraction
transferFrom rewrites balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath
transferFrom increments the sender sale counter _onSaleNum[_from]
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly
ensure compares _from against the UNI router constant
ensure grants unrestricted transfer when _from equals tradeAddress
ensure grants unrestricted transfer when canSale[_from] is true
ensure falls back to condition() when the sender is not whitelisted
ensure derives the Uniswap pair address through pairFor
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to cap how often an address may sell
condition blocks transfers once _saleNum is reached
condition rejects amounts below _minSale
condition rejects amounts above _maxSale
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall into caller-supplied code, reentering/exfiltrating storage on behalf of the contract
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] using addedValue * 10**decimals
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true, whitelisting arbitrary addresses
init assigns _saleNum from the saleNum parameter
init assigns _minSale from the token parameter
init assigns _maxSale from the maxToken parameter
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length and mutates balanceOf entries inside a loop without SafeMath
setTradeAddress writes the whitelisted tradeAddress
constructor sets owner = msg.sender
constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the whole supply
constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router address
constructor computes totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals
constructor uses decimals to scale the supply
constructor references the UNI router constant as allowance spender
callOptionalReturn performs the low-level call on the supplied token address
_to is forwarded from transfer into transferFrom as the recipient
_to is the credited recipient in transferFrom
_value is subtracted from balances and allowances in transferFrom
_from is the debited sender in transferFrom
_from is checked against owner, UNI, pair, tradeAddress and canSale inside ensure
_spender is the allowance beneficiary written by approve
a is the target contract of the owner-only delegatecall
b is the caller-supplied calldata forwarded to delegatecall
spender receives the overwritten balance and canSale flag in _mints
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals before being stored as balanceOf[spender]
saleNum is stored into _saleNum by init
token is scaled by 10**decimals and stored into _minSale
maxToken is scaled by 10**decimals and stored into _maxSale
_tos array drives total = _value * _tos.length and the per-recipient credits
loop index i controls iteration over _tos in batchSend
addr is stored into the tradeAddress whitelist slot
factory is hashed into the computed Uniswap pair address
tokenA participates in the pair hash computation ordering
tokenB participates in the pair hash computation ordering
pair is the keccak256-derived return value of pairFor

_value is the amount parameter consumed by transferFrom arithmetic
_from is the sender parameter that transferFrom debits and validates
_spender is only used to key the allowance mapping in approve
a is the delegatecall target parameter of delegate
b is the delegatecall payload parameter of delegate
spender is the beneficiary parameter of the _mints balance overwrite
addedValue is the amount parameter of the _mints balance overwrite
saleNum is the sale-count parameter stored by init
token is the minimum-amount parameter scaled and stored by init
maxToken is the maximum-amount parameter scaled and stored by init
_tos is the recipient array parameter driving the batchSend loop
i is the local loop counter that only exists within batchSend
addr is the new whitelist value parameter written by setTradeAddress
factory is a hashing input parameter of pairFor
tokenA is a hashing input parameter of pairFor
tokenB is a hashing input parameter of pairFor
pair is the local return value produced inside pairFor
